digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store / GET-rotation sidecar
propositions: Extract and persist GET-rotation state to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json as a focused rotation module with fail-open sidecar load/save, reading max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) per Jira key and dual-writing new stamps to both sidecar and legacy inline field during rollout.
Idempotent real-repo passes with no absent-key GETs after rotation initialization must leave all committed bridge-state files byte-identical and not advance HEAD.

Passes with absent-key GETs advance the same Jira-key rotation stamps in both get_rotation.json and legacy inline fields, staged and committed together via explicit binding-store commit path without git add -A.
Interleaved old-binary and new-binary pass sequences must produce identical rotation order as all-new sequences, verified by dual-write and max() read semantics.
Legacy inline-only stores must preserve rotation order on load and materialize equivalent sidecar state on the next persisted save.
reconcile-check must not create get_rotation.json, must leave git status clean, and outbound_differ.py must remain at or below 800 lines.
